subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted-disconnect fallback stay recook-first with a fresh session for this PR, or should this PR pause until the reattach-first direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 is chosen?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session duplicate-turn bug, but it intentionally preserves duplicate execution and possible duplicate delivery as the fallback behavior after gateway acceptance.

options.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook-first boundary for now, merge this session-state fix, and leave reattach-first recovery as the broader follow-up.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first before merge
options.body: Hold this PR and require it to wait on or implement the product direction from the related issue so accepted disconnects try to recover the authoritative gateway result first.

options.title: Reject recook-first for accepted disconnects
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide any post-acceptance local rerun is unacceptable even on a fresh session.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook-first boundary for now, merge this session-state fix, and leave reattach-first recovery as the broader follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership covers both the CLI fallback region and the gateway accepted-run/dedupe contract this choice depends on.
